checks: Replay two real malformed v1 submit_audit argument strings without silently rewriting them
One audit correction round at most, within the same durable request allowance
Function-call corrections receive matching call_id error outputs and never execute business tools
Validate JSON citations only against observed JSON values or subtrees, without filesystem access
Distinguish JSON Pointer root, empty object keys, escaped tokens and strict array indexes
Reject unknown paths, unavailable pointers and conflicting observation values
Citation correction has no tools and cannot change other claim fields
Keep citation check results out of the independent blind assessment context
Preserve request and correction counts across both correction timeout recovery paths
Keep decision correctness independent from citation validity and coverage
historical_replay_note: Checks original end-to-end pass flags only, without modifying any historical report. Frozen audit had no API attempts; its zero is not a model score.
limitations: Scripted resubmission tests validate the mechanism, not future model correction success
Citation location does not establish scientific support or correct experimental reasoning
Plain-text answers are outside the structured JSON citation contract
Real-model v2 performance still requires a separate bounded evaluation with new report names
